WHATSAPP_FLOWS.TITLE: Forms
WHATSAPP_FLOWS.NEW_HINT: A WhatsApp form (Meta Flow) opens inside the chat and comes back as structured data: each answer lands on the conversation or contact, and the automation goes on from there. Start from a ready-made template or paste your own Flow JSON.
WHATSAPP_FLOWS.NAME: Name
WHATSAPP_FLOWS.CREATED: Form created as a draft. Publish it when it is ready.
WHATSAPP_FLOWS.ADVANCED_HINT: Flow JSON exactly as Meta documents it. Meta validates it when saved; errors show up on the form.
WHATSAPP_FLOWS.EMPTY: No forms yet. Create the first one above.
WHATSAPP_FLOWS.VALIDATION_ERRORS: Meta found {count} problem(s) in the JSON
WHATSAPP_FLOWS.PUBLISHED_OK: Form published. It can be sent to customers now.
WHATSAPP_FLOWS.DEPRECATED_OK: Form deprecated. It can no longer be sent.
WHATSAPP_FLOWS.PREVIEW_HINT: Refresh from Meta to get a preview link.
WHATSAPP_FLOWS.SAVED: Form saved and resent to Meta.
WHATSAPP_FLOWS.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete this form? Only drafts can be deleted.
WHATSAPP_FLOWS.INVALID_JSON: The Flow JSON is not valid JSON.
WHATSAPP_FLOWS.SEND_HINT: To send it, add a "Send form" step to a Chatflow.
